label: Beginner · Lesson 34
title: In town
intro: Places in town and directions: Where is the bank? Go straight. Turn left. Today’s words and what we learnt before.
intro_uz: Shahardagi joylar va yo’l ko’rsatish. Bugungi so’zlar va oldingi mavzular.
message: Beginner · Lesson 34 · In town. Do it before the next lesson. Rasmga oling yoki chop eting.

parts.title: Asking the way
items: Is there a bank near here? Yes, there {is|are}.
The bus stop is {next to|next} the park.

parts.title: Write the words
items: The bank is ___ to the hospital.

parts.title: Put the words in order
items: a / there / café / Is / near here / ?
is / on / The shop / the left

parts.title: What we learnt before
items: My brother {gets up|get up} at seven.
{How much|How many} is it? It’s 5,000 so’m.

parts.title: Write about your street
parts.uz: Uyingiz yonidagi joylar haqida 4 ta gap yozing

items.prompt: Write 4 sentences about places near your house.
items.hint: Example: There is a shop near my house. The bus stop is next to the park.
